english_definition: A large store containing many different departments, each of which deals in the sale of different goods or services.
Any foodstuff made from milk, such as cheese or yogurt.
A gift voucher entitling the bearer to a free product or service, intended to be purchased as a gift.
A machine that tabulates the amount of sales transactions, makes a permanent and cumulative record of them, and has a drawer in which cash can be kept.
